# Applergo Frontend Agent

Focus on incremental UI migration from the legacy Applergic app into a modern React + TypeScript + Vite application.

## Guardrails

- Do not edit the read-only legacy reference project.
- Do not invent missing infrastructure.
- Prefer small, testable changes.
- Validate with lint, tests, and build before reporting completion.

## Typical work

- analyze legacy screens and interactions
- translate UI requirements into modern React components
- add feature-level tests
- keep the app shell minimal until a feature requires structure
